title: Information Day: Map Your Pathway and Finalise Your Choices with RMIT
content_markdown:
# Information Day: Map Your Pathway and Finalise Your Choices with RMIT

## Event Details

Date: 19 July 2026
Time: 8:00 AM - 12:00 PM
Cost: FREE
Locations: RMIT Saigon South and RMIT Hanoi

## Venues

- Hanoi Campus: 521 Kim Ma, Giang Vo Ward, Hanoi City
- Saigon South Campus: 702 Nguyen Van Linh, Tan Hung Ward, Ho Chi Minh City

## Event Highlights

Attendees can learn about RMIT's 19 undergraduate programs across business, creative, engineering and science disciplines. The event features one-on-one consultations regarding program options, admission requirements, and scholarship opportunities.

Additional highlights include guided campus tours, conversations with current students, and exploration of diverse exchange and transfer opportunities to RMIT Melbourne and over 200 partner universities worldwide.

## Exclusive Sessions

At RMIT Hanoi: Workshop titled "Marketing 101: From flop to top trending" facilitated by Ms My Bui, Foundation Studies Teacher

At RMIT Saigon South: Panel discussion called "Start strong - Stay ready from year one" featuring RMIT representatives, student perspectives, and parent insights

## Special Offer

Attendees who submit applications at the event receive an application fee waiver valued at 2,000,000 VND.

## Undergraduate Programs Offered

The Business School: Business (9 majors, 13 minors), Tourism and Hospitality Management, Digital Marketing, Accounting

School of Science, Engineering and Technology: Information Technology, Engineering specializations (Software, Robotics/Mechatronics, Electronic/Computer Systems), Applied Science (Aviation), Psychology, Food Technology and Nutrition, Computer Science

School of Communication and Design: Professional Communication, Digital Film and Video, Design specializations, Fashion (Enterprise), International Studies
